correctness.rationale: The factorization T_Re_n=n^-R v_n with v_n=(sqrt(w_j)n^-s_j) gives H_R=T_R*T_R and m-dimensional zeta Gram G_R=Σn^-2R v_nv_n*, with finite trace since s_j>0,R>=1. Strictly increasing distinct s_j imply independence of v_1,..,v_k by the Chebyshev/exponential-polynomial zero lemma, so Δ_k>0 and rank=m. Exterior-power compound expansion into positive u_Iu_I* terms has unique minimum index product k! for I={1,..,k}, with squared leading wedge norm Δ_k; all other tuple products >=(k-1)!(k+1). The tail is summable using Σn^-2 and bounded v_n, giving norm asymptotic Δ_k/(k!)^(2R)[1+O((k/(k+1))^(2R))]. Divide consecutive top k eigenvalue products to get λ_k=(Δ_k/Δ_{k-1})k^-2R[1+O((k/(k+1))^(2R))]. Thus eigenvalue hierarchy, simplicity and optimal compact rank-r norm error follow. Independently checked exact rational Δ1=14, Δ2=133/64, Δ3=1/324 for the provided three-vector diagnostic; finite identities are corroboration only.
